farm.name: Farms and grain depots
farm.text: Grain fields, silos and a railhead depot. Lightly guarded: a few machine guns and a 40 mm battery by the silos.

mine.name: Mines and steelworks
mine.text: Pitheads, spoil heaps and a rolling mill. Steel for the yards, guarded by heavy flak along the slag banks.

oil.name: Oil works
oil.text: Derricks, a tank farm and a small refinery. Its oil sells for hard currency, and its flak gunners know it.

industry.name: Industrial works
industry.text: Sheds, chimneys and rail sidings: an arms and engine works rebuilt since the war, ringed with heavy flak.

airfield.name: Airfield
airfield.text: Runways, hangars and dispersal pens. Its fighters rise to defend every structure of its flag within 300 km, and its search planes report ships that come within reach.

battery.name: Coastal battery
battery.text: Heavy guns in concrete casemates on a headland. Its guns reach some 35 km to sea, and it shells any ship of a flag at war with its own that comes within range.

radar.name: Radar station
radar.text: Aerial masts and a plotting room on high ground. Its warning makes the flak and fighters of every structure of its flag within 300 km a quarter more effective, and warns of attack.

navalbase.name: Naval base
navalbase.text: A wartime harbour: a breakwater, oil tanks, a slipway and a repair shop. Whoever holds it can repair, rearm and refuel there, and it keeps the goods its holder's structures produce.

nuclear.name: Nuclear plant
nuclear.text: Reactor halls, cooling towers and a separation works behind three fences. Only a power that holds a working plant can make nuclear warheads: one a month from each. Strike it, take it or destroy it, and that power makes no more.
